mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Area High School and a moderate air quality index of 53. The moon phase is a waning crescent, and we are looking at an overnight low of 65 degrees with rain expected to move in.

The City of Verona remains committed to maintaining our infrastructure through a long-standing contract with AECOM. Detailed engineering reports are provided for public review at every city council meeting, and you can view the historical list of these reports on the city website.

There is plenty to do, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can head downtown for the Dane County Farmers Market on the Square or check out the music series at Paddy Mac's.

A noteworthy call for service occurred on Thursday, July 30, when an officer stopped a vehicle for equipment violations. The driver was arrested for O W I, and she also faced citations for suspended registration and operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration.

Today is the perfect time to enjoy the Really Reese's flavor of the day at Culver's. They are open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by. Also, don't forget that Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4 PM.
